verdict.rationale: Composio ships an official CLI. It supports authentication via `composio login --agent` and installs into agents via `composio setup --target auto`, which adds the native plugin for Codex or Claude Code. However, nothing shows the CLI staging, building, or pushing a server: MCP server creation is documented only through the SDK (`composio.mcp.create`) and sessions. Missing for 10: CLI commands to build or stage a server, CLI push/publish/deploy of a server, and any independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI workflow.
